title: On the errors committed by sequences of estimator functionals
summary: Consider a sequence of estimators $\hat θ_n$ which converges almost surely to $θ_0$ as the sample size $n$ tends to infinity. Under weak smoothness conditions, we identify the asymptotic limit of the last time $\hat θ_n$ is further than $\eps$ away from $θ_0$ when $\eps \rightarrow 0^+$. These limits lead to the construction of sequentially fixed width confidence regions for which we find analytic approximations.
